meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以创建、读取、修改和保存 AnnData 数据结构（单细胞等带注释矩阵的标准格式），支持 h5ad、zarr 等文件读写，并能做子集筛选、拼接合并、格式转换等操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 .h5ad 文件、使用单细胞 RNA-seq 数据，或与 scanpy、scvi-tools 等 scverse 生态工具对接时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 data.h5ad 文件，统计细胞数和基因数。
将这份数据用压缩方式保存为 output.h5ad。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, modify, and save AnnData objects (the standard annotated-matrix format for single-cell and similar data), read/write h5ad and zarr files, subset, concatenate, and convert formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to work with .h5ad files, single-cell RNA-seq data, or integrate with scverse tools like scanpy or scvi-tools.

say_en.text: Read this data.h5ad file and report the number of cells and genes.

say_en.text: Concatenate batch1.h5ad and batch2.h5ad into one, labeling the batch.
